name: ComboCounter
description: Hitting mobs without taking damage builds a rising combo shown on your action bar, with each hit dealing a little more damage until you get hit or the combo times out.
usage: Punch a few mobs in a row without getting hit and watch the combo counter climb on your action bar
manual: Land hits on mobs (not other players) without taking any damage and your combo counter climbs, shown on your action bar along with the bonus damage it's currently adding. Each hit while your combo is active deals extra damage on top of normal damage, calculated from the damage-bonus-per-combo knob (default 0.5) times your current combo minus one. Combo caps at max-combo (default 20) hits so the bonus damage doesn't spiral forever. Taking any damage at all - from a mob, a fall, fire, or anything else - instantly resets your combo to zero. If you go too long without landing a hit, the combo also resets on its own after combo-timeout-seconds of inactivity (default 5 seconds). Turn off show-actionbar (default true) if you'd rather not see the combo messages at all. Every hit also gets a little crit particle burst and an attack sound that pitches up slightly as your combo grows.
creator: player
